title: メダル四万枚グランドレビュー
genre: Japanese revue show tune (Osaka all-female revue style)
subject: Yoshie, seventy-four, who has forty thousand medals banked at a game centre above an Osaka supermarket, worthless anywhere else and wiped if she stays away sixty days, so she clocks in at the coin pusher daily and tips kids a cupful like candy.
caption: Japanese revue show tune, Osaka all-female revue style, easy two-beat march. Trumpet section with bright fanfares and punchy off-beat stabs, trombones with sliding fills and big unison hits, string section playing sweeping unison lines that lift each chorus, xylophone with quick sparkling runs at phrase ends, snare drum and tuba keeping a two-beat march with press rolls into each chorus. Live theatre-orchestra recording with the voice upfront. Female lead, husky alto, big warm full voice with comic timing and a light Osaka accent. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 116 BPM, B-flat major. Wry, big-hearted, easygoing. No rap, no autotune, no EDM synths, no rock drums, no trap beats.
lyrics:
[Intro - trumpet fanfare, trombone slides, xylophone run]

[Verse 1]
スーパーの にかいの
ゲームセンター いつもの
コインおしの まえに
よしえ ななじゅうよん

[Pre-Chorus]
メダル よんまんまい
こないと ろくじゅうにちで
メダルは ぜんぶ きえる

[Chorus]
まいにち まいにち
ここが わたしの ぶたい
メダル よんまんまい
グランドレビュー

[Verse 2]
こどもに ひとカップ
あめのように あげる
おおきに ばあちゃん
よしえは えがおで

[Pre-Chorus]
そとでは ただの かたまり
ここじゃ おおばんぶるまい

[Chorus]
きょうも まいにち
ここが わたしの ぶたい
メダル よんまんまい
グランドレビュー

[Outro - trumpet fanfare, snare press roll, tuba]
